Executive Summary — Apr–Jul 2026
🏆 Key Highlights
🥇
@narendramodi tops with 113 Cr+ views from 1,121 tweets — highest reach per tweet ratio
📈
BJP dominates with 77% share of total tweets and 67% of all views across tracked handles
🔥
Jun 5 was peak day with 30,241 tweets — highest single-day posting volume
⏰
Peak tweeting hour is 11–12 AM IST with 46,395 tweets — busiest posting window
🌍
UP leads all states with 153,704 tweets, followed by Gujarat (59,328) and Madhya Pradesh (56,190)
📊 Sentiment Insights
💬
85.2% of all tweets are Neutral — politicians prefer factual/informational communication
✅
13.3% Positive tweets across all tracked handles
⚠️
Only 1.5% Negative tweets overall — indicates controlled, strategic communication
🔖
86,865,755 total likes recorded across all handles — strong engagement on policy/governance content
📌
#mannkibaat top hashtag with 3,293 mentions, followed by #bjp (2,845)
🏛️ Party Performance
🪷
BJP: 498,914 tweets · 235.07 Cr views · 72,509 positive · 1696 active handles
✋
INC: 53,258 tweets · 44.24 Cr views · 1.81 Cr likes · 402 handles
⚡
SP: 16,505 tweets · 13.68 Cr views · concentrated in Uttar Pradesh
🌟
DMK: 7,387 tweets · 4.49 Cr views — Tamil Nadu dominated
🏛
Others (AAP/TDP/SS/JD(U)/etc.): 72,624 tweets · 56.23 Cr views — diverse coalition voices
